_comment: Known feature-E2E failures. Each entry: { case, gap, reason }. Shrink-only: a new failure fails CI, and an entry whose case now passes must be removed in the same change.

company-master.reason: The executable T02 case opens /masters/companies and requires the desktop New action plus editable identity fields; the current milestone intentionally exposes only a read-only Code/Name list, so the rich identity workflow remains missing under G38/N58.

sales-order.reason: Old gold, old silver (SL_PR_DETL) and scheme amounts are read-only on the order (cash, cheque and card are taken since N197, UPI since this change), so an advance cannot include them (TR_SALE_ORD.cs:11368, Ac_Ledr.cs:42-50).

data-backup.reason: The real v2 archive has no versioned tenantConfig section or allowlist because D-BKP-3 has not approved the NextMain-equivalent configuration and credential envelope.
